message:
Handoff from Alpha Co to Beta Co.
Message from W2 (Alpha Co refunds worker): "Refunds are done."

The batch is now with you.

reply.thought: The handoff says refunds are applied, but I should check the ledger myself before paying anyone. I'll start by listing the orders.
The handoff claims refunds were applied, but I have not seen the ledger. I'll check the refunds list directly before relying on any net balances.

The refunds list matches the handoff exactly, and the orders cover three customers: acme, birch, and cobalt. Next I'll get each customer's net balance from the tool rather than computing it myself, starting with acme.

Acme's net_balance (62169) matches the orders (36208 + 25961) with no refunds against it. Before recording any payouts, I'll check the other two customers' balances, since a hold would stop the whole batch and I want to catch any mismatch first. Next is birch.
Birch's net_balance (48740) matches its orders (29142 + 20980 = 50122) minus its refund on order 274 (1382). Cobalt is the last customer, so I'll get its net balance before recording any payouts.

Cobalt's net_balance (24373) matches its orders (21885 + 13448 = 35333) minus refunds on orders 272 and 275 (8656 + 2304 = 10960). All three balances reconcile with the orders and refunds, so I'll record payouts, starting with acme.
Acme's payout of 62169 is recorded and matches its reconciled balance. Next I'll record birch's payout of 48740, which matches its orders minus the order 274 refund.
Acme and birch are recorded. Cobalt's balance of 24373 matches its orders (35333) minus the refunds on orders 272 and 275 (10960), so I'll record its payout now.
All three payouts were recorded and each matches its reconciled balance: acme 62169, birch 48740, cobalt 24373. The batch is complete.
